aboutLede: CallMe2Serve is a global expert marketplace: Next.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Redux, Socket.io, and JWT — no Redis, no identity-card check.
aboutP1: One expert account can ask for work or open a shop. Desk is a separate company seat that watches the board — it does not approve each payment. Job pay creates a real receipt and auto-releases the expert net.
aboutP2: Place is a live GPS pin. A shop goes on the map only with a pin and a door photo. Language is separate from currency. Debit card is a rail; cash is not offered.
aboutP3: We grow city by city worldwide. Job commission is 0% for free and paid experts for now — rates can be turned on later without changing receipts today. Referrers share package fees when someone upgrades; worker net is never shrunk by referral.

howItWorksLede: The same flow drawn in the phone and laptop frames — built without Redis and without an identity-card check.
howStep1Body: Google or Facebook creates the account. Finish work, city, languages, then enrol fingerprint or face.
howStep2Body: Settings → Place uses real GPS. Nearby experts and shops are ordered by distance.
howStep3Body: Quotation + visit fee + preferred rail. Worker accepts. Asker pays with wallet, PayPal/Google Pay, or debit.
howStep4Body: Payment writes a real receipt (quote, visit, commission, net). Rate only after the job is completed.
howStep5Body: Create the shop, capture the door pin, upload a door photo. Both are required before LIVE.
